name: D12 coverage-controlled deterministic/multimodal/router ladder
status: frozen before D12 history replay or model fitting
purpose: test whether broader generic interaction coverage repairs response-curve generalization without changing the existing model families
scope: combined D3+D12 TRAIN corpus only; DEV and TEST remain closed

data.normalization: fit groups only; nested endpoints flattened only for state/action/response statistics

history_replay.construction: warm-start-safe replay from the original episode chunk through the selected source path and event step

models.deterministic: unchanged D9b shared exact-zero amplitude times six level-specific nonnegative shapes
models.multimodal: unchanged D10 three-component complete-curve mixture with MAP deployment and oracle-best diagnostic
models.router: unchanged D11 event router over frozen D10 experts; labels are minimum curve error inside fit only

optimization.execution: one sequential GPU model at a time

decision.pass_both_axes: replicate fixed seeds 2 and 3 before any DEV run
decision.otherwise: do not tune on validation; report whether failure is fidelity, specificity, recall, or routing and reconsider the privileged model/monitor interface
decision.joint_validation: diagnostic only and never used for model or checkpoint selection
